reviews.x: The one they originally sent me had a minor defect that I was able to correct easily. I wasn't even gonna complain to them about it because I was already happy with the product. reviews.t: Product is exactly as described. I contacted them because ...
reviews.x: Product is exactly as described.  I contacted them because the appeared used.  But, they reminded me to peel off the protective wrap.  They were quick to respond and very helpful.

This holder is so convenient. Immediately stopped the issue of my fiancé and I having to ask one another for the remote control. We have multiple remote controls (one for our fan, one for the TV, one for our Firestick). This organizer is now hung right above our bed where a headboard would typically be. The 3M Velcro stickies that came with the organizer hold it firmly to the wall. All 3 remotes fit perfectly. I don't know how we lived without this before!

claims.text: Customers find the holder convenient for organizing and keeping track of multiple remotes, often mounting it above the bed.
The included adhesive/velcro is a common weak point, with several reviewers reporting the holder falling off the wall and cracking or breaking.
Customer service is responsive and helpful, resolving issues like a minor defect or confusion over protective wrap.
Some reviewers report missing or inadequate mounting hardware and packaging concerns.
The product is simple and does what it's supposed to, though some note it's not the most aesthetically pleasing or strongest plastic.
